capabilities: Build interactive character sheets from YAML code blocks
Track HP, hit dice, death saves, spell slots, and consumables across sessions
Run combat with an initiative tracker for turn order and combatant HP
Render badges, stat cards, and spell component panels with dynamic {{ }} templates
Read note frontmatter properties and apply one of 21 adjustable themes
extras: Full configuration reference and live demos live on an external documentation site; tracker state is stored in a JSON file in the vault (.ttrpg-ui-toolkit-state.json by default). The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: The author was tired of juggling PDFs and web tools for characters and wanted notes, spells, and current state in one place in the vault.
problem: Obsidian notes are static, so tracking character state like HP, spell slots and initiative means juggling separate PDFs and web tools.

relations.evidence: 21 themes, light and dark, including companions for the ITS theme

summary: Interactive character sheet and GM toolkit that renders D&D 5e and system-agnostic trackers from YAML code blocks inside notes.
